description.value: Bourbon St. Grill is a Cajun/Creole-inspired fast-food counter located in the Metrotown food court in Burnaby, serving dishes like blackened chicken, jambalaya rice, and mashed potatoes in a quick-service, choose-your-own-combo format. It is one of several BC locations of the chain and sits inside one of Metro Vancouver's largest transit-accessible shopping centres. For a cyclist passing through Burnaby on Kingsway, it offers a fast, affordable, hot meal with confirmed bike parking and free Wi-Fi.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 62m; stands (8 spaces) at 65m; rack (6 spaces) at 97m. Total: 24 spaces.

Multiple customer reviews dated April–May 2026 confirm the Metrotown food-court location is actively operating; the OSM-supplied URL was discovered with uncertain confidence but the page content unambiguously matches this business at 4800 Kingsway, Burnaby.
